note: XXVII fills A: the drive 1–4 Nov, the Borgo by-road, the chapel · Booth style · no moon
style: An oil painting in colour of 1893 with the drama of Franklin Booth: monumental scale, deep recession, towering forms, strong value contrast and deep shadow, light breaking through haze, a sense of awe. Loose visible brushstrokes, thick impasto in the lights, thin glazes in the shadows, soft lost edges. Cold early-November light in the Carpathians, snow, low sun; no golden glow except at sunset. No moon in any sky. Any face is small and unreadable. No text, signature or border.

beats.text: Shot: very wide. A Romanian mountain village on 1 November 1893: a light carriage halting at a wooden inn to change horses, peasants in sheepskins small around it, a wayside cross, steep roofs with first snow, the Carpathian spurs rising beyond.

Shot: very wide. Night on 1 November 1893: a small carriage with a single lantern driving fast along a lonely road across a snowy upland under a vast starry sky with no moon, dark forest edges, the mountains black against the stars.

Shot: very wide. A bright cold morning on 2 November 1893: a carriage small on a long road across a high plateau, a strange heavy grey haze over the land, the low sun pale through it, the Carpathians looming.

Shot: very wide. The great spurs of the Carpathian mountains towering close above a wild valley on a cold November afternoon in 1893, dark pine forests, snow on the summits, a small carriage on the road far below.

Shot: medium-wide. A wooden wayside crucifix shrine with a little roof standing in fresh snow at a crossroads in the Carpathians in 1893, a few peasant women in shawls kneeling small before it, pines and mountains behind, cold light.

Shot: wide, no faces. A fire burning in a ring of stones on the snow at dawn high in the Carpathians, a travelling rug, a leather notebook and a pencil beside it, the carriage and horses beyond, steep mountains, pale cold sky.

Shot: very wide. A neglected mountain by-road branching off from the coach road in the Borgo Pass in November 1893, lightly snowed over, a small carriage taking it, dark pines leaning over, the old track climbing into the mountains.

Shot: very wide. A wild desert land high in the Carpathians in November 1893: great frowning precipices, white waterfalls falling down the cliffs, a small carriage on the road at their foot, dark cloud on the peaks.

Shot: medium-wide, no people. Inside a ruined castle chapel, a huge nobly proportioned stone tomb standing alone, a shaft of cold daylight falling on it through a broken window, dust and old leaves on the floor, deep shadow.

Shot: close, no people. A great iron-studded castle door in a stone arch, small white pieces of the sacred wafer pressed into the cracks around its frame, a hammer lying on the threshold, cold grey light, snow drifting in.
Shot: close, no people. On the dusty lid of a stone tomb in a ruined chapel, a heavy hammer, sharpened wooden stakes and a lantern, a shaft of grey light, deep shadow.
